title: Records moved from 38.31, with and without their own times, on one day (decisions I5 and J2)
story: A 38.31 copy, last saved Tue 24 Nov 2026 at 08:00, is moved that morning. Its bank figure of 300,000 was typed on Sun 22 Nov at 18:00 (it has its own time), so the bank opens on 22 Nov, told at 18:00. Its receipts: 4,000 on Sat 21 Nov with no time; on 22 Nov, 2,000 at 12:00, 5,000 with no time and 1,000 at 20:00; 3,000 on Mon 23 Nov with no time. On Wed 25 Nov the person checks the bank: 290,000. I5: a moved record is told at its own time when it has one. J2 (correcting I5 to agree with SCHEMA_V3 11.1): a moved receipt with no time is told at the start of its day, so one dated on or before the bank figure's day is inside it. So the 12:00 receipt and the 5,000 with no time are inside the 18:00 figure; the 20:00 one comes after it, and so does the 23 Nov one. No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.

events.note: receipt, no time: told at the start of its day (J2), so inside the figure
receipt with its own time, after the figure
receipt, no time: told at the start of 23 Nov, after the figure's day

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (bank figure 22 Nov at 18:00) - 1,000 (22 Nov at 20:00, after the figure) - 3,000 (23 Nov, no time: told at the start of 23 Nov, after the figure's day) = 296,000
asks.note: J2: the 21 Nov 4,000, the 22 Nov 2,000 at 12:00 and the 22 Nov 5,000 with no time (told at the start of 22 Nov) are all inside the figure. Before I5 the model read every moved receipt on 22 Nov as inside the figure, the 20:00 one too: 297,000.

I5.why: 300,000 (bank figure 22 Nov at 18:00) - 5,000 (22 Nov, no time: told at the save, 24 Nov 08:00, so after the figure) - 1,000 (22 Nov at 20:00) - 3,000 (23 Nov) = 291,000
I5.rule: I5 as first written: a moved record with no time is told at the copy's last save (J2 corrected this)

asks.question: not_explained
asks.why: 296,000 (what the events say at the 25 Nov check) - 290,000 (the check) = 6,000

I5.why: 291,000 (what the events say at the 25 Nov check, with the 5,000 after the figure) - 290,000 (the check) = 1,000
I5.rule: I5 as first written: a moved record with no time is told at the copy's last save (J2 corrected this)
